candidates.name: Iran-UAE (Salman-Sharjah) Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) / Crescent Petroleum (Dana Gas)
candidates.from: Salman gas field (offshore Iran, Persian Gulf)

evidence.note: 2001 NIOC-Crescent 25-yr deal to pipe Salman-field gas to Sharjah; NIOC sent test gas through the pipeline to Dana Gas' Sharjah facility in 2010 before pipeline leaks forced a halt; commercial supply never began.
Arbitration tribunal awarded Dana Gas/Crescent $607.5m; 2001 contract obliged NIOC to supply ~600 mmcfd from the Salman field to Sharjah, deliveries due from 2005/2008 but never made.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Cross-border export line from Iran to the UAE; physically built and even test-flowed in 2010 (30-inch UAE-side receiving line, ~600 mmcfd) but never entered commercial service and remains dormant/dead. Not in the roster: P3950 Salman-Siri is a domestic offshore line (Salman/Lavan to Siri Island inside Iran), a different direction; P3949 Siri-Asaluyeh and P3174 'Off-Shore Gas Pipeline' (proposed, 1500 km) are also domestic/unclear. Consolidator should confirm it is not folded into P3174. Distinct cross-border UAE-directed export project.

candidates.name: Iran-Nakhchivan Gas Pipeline (Julfa)
candidates.from: Northwest Iran (gas enters at Astara from Azerbaijan under swap)
candidates.to: Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic (Azerbaijan exclave), delivered at Julfa

evidence.note: Azerbaijan signed a 20-yr agreement with Iran in 2004 to supply Nakhchivan; implemented from 2005; ~350 mcm/yr with 15% deducted as transit fee; Iran delivers gas across its territory to Nakhchivan because Azerbaijan proper has no land border with the exclave.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Operating cross-border transit/delivery line touching Iran (gas enters Iran at Astara, is carried across NW Iran and handed to Nakhchivan at Julfa) since 2005; ~0.3-0.4 bcm/yr. Not in the roster as a distinct entity: P0748 Hajiqabul-Astara-Abadan covers the Azerbaijan->Iran import at Astara, and P0449 Iran-Armenia is a different border. CAVEAT for the consolidator: this may be operated as a swap over existing IGAT/regional infrastructure rather than a dedicated new-build spur to Julfa, and physical-pipeline specs (length/diameter) could not be pinned to a single verified source. Emit for a match/keep decision; could be treated as part of P0748's system.
